## Overview

This project explores the relationship between fuel efficiency and engine displacement using Python, pandas, seaborn, and matplotlib.

## Tools

- Python
- pandas
- seaborn
- matplotlib

## Analysis

```{python}
#| message: false
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = sns.load_dataset("mpg").dropna()

sns.scatterplot(x="mpg", y="displacement", data=df)
plt.show()
```

The relationship between fuel efficiency (`mpg`) and engine displacement is negative, with a correlation of `{python} float(round(df["mpg"].corr(df["displacement"]), 2))`.
